The model of the car, Spaces and dashes used numbers as well. Includes trim level, so 911 carrera is different from 911 carrera GT
Used or certified from a dealer (make), IE. Dodge certified. Should remove the brand and just call it certified since we already have a make field
Price of the car following this format $xxx,xxx
Rating that the consumer of the car has given it on the cars.com website. 0.0 - 5
How many reviews consumers have given. Straight number no commas
Sold from a dealer or private individual, 2 string options,
The name of the Seller, can be pretty long with the dealer names.
The rating the seller gives to the vehicle 0.0 - 5
how many reviews the seller has given, no commas
The Street of where the vehicle is being sold, probably can remove since we have the state
The state code of where the vehicle is being sold. For example: MI for michigan
the zipcode where the car is being sold. Split between digits and some are listed in characters. Fix or remove those.
A cars.com classification if the vehicle price is considered a good deal or not. Fair, good, great, N/A
The rating of the comfortability for the vehicle 0.0 - 5
The rating of the design and feel for the inside of the vehicle 0.0 - 5
the rating for the performance of the vehicle from 0.0 - 5
A rating from 0.0 - 5 on how good of a car you are getting versus the price
The rating of the exterior looks of the vehicles from 0.0 -5
How reliable the vehicle is from 0.0 - 5
The exterior color the car is. Spaces and dashs, some weird characters, some numbers as well

Whether the vehicle is front-wheel, four-wheel, rear-wheel or all-wheel. Some listed as FWD, RWD, AWD, 4WD. Pick either and make them the same. Some weird characters need to be removed
1 to 3 digit number describing the min miles per galon of the vehicle when driving
1 to 3 digit number describing the max miles per galon of the vehicle when driving
There are really 4 types, Gasoline, desiel, hybrid, electric. Anything else needs to be put into these categories.

What type of engine is in the vehicle. Numbers and letters, slashes and spaces

How many miles are the vehicle has already been driven, up to 6 numbers no commas.
